svg.title: The flow identity
svg.desc: What PartialEq, Eq and Hash compare, on the DNS query: the source and destination of each layer and its protocol, MAC addresses, IP addresses, ports, and the application label. Payloads and details are left out, so two packets of the same conversation compare equal.
